description: This Java class defines a helper class 'UIAnimation' that manages animated transitions for UI components in an Android application. It handles zoom-in and zoom-out animations of icons with associated state management and callback notifications.

classes.name: UIAnimation
classes.description: A helper class providing zoom-in and zoom-out animations for icon views in an Android UI, managing animation states and transition callbacks.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIState
classes.description: Enumeration representing various UI states triggered by icon interactions: MIC_UP, SOUND_UP, MUSIC_UP, and HOME.

classes.name: UIAnimation.UIStateListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to UI state change events triggered during animations.

methods.name: UIAnimation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UIAnimation with container view, thumb icons, expanded view, animation duration, and listener, setting up click handlers.

methods.name: zoomImageFromThumb
methods.description: Handles the zoom-in animation when an icon is clicked, expanding it with property animations and setting up click handlers for zoom-out.

methods.name: transitionToHome
methods.description: Method to transition the UI back to the 'home' state by invoking the zoom-out animation.
